x: Former RAF 3-miles champion Bill Merryman must be proud of his nephews. The handicap, however, went to Steven Wilson, one of several highly promising lads, who was third in the scratch race.
Two other Bels, who were on this occasion running for their school, Shene Grammar, were Steven Wilson, 24th in 17m. 19s., and Stephen Jay, 56th in 22m. 12s.
Numerous wins in Inter-house and Inter-schools races. STEVEN WILSON
Steven Wilson was 3rd in 15.39. and Howard Breslin 9th in 16.23. Ivan Beaumont clocked 17.20 and Steven Jay 18.37.
